name: First Technical Debt Sweep
description: Full-org technical debt scan across all 4 pods and 3 shared services. Every RD, DS, DE, and AE agent scans their domain for 6 categories of debt: dead code, deprecated/superseded code, duplication/drift risk, hardcoded configuration, orphaned infrastructure, and stale error handling. DS and RD report to their pod's DE. AEs 0.5.0 and 0.6.0 report to 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps. 5 aggregate reports (4 DE + 1 AE) go to COO, who synthesizes for CTO + Andrew. Targeted cleanup task orders (.002+) issued from findings.
